prompt: (HL) 5% of students cheat. A detector flags 90% of cheaters and 10% of honest students. A student is flagged. Find P(cheater | flagged) (3 s.f.).
(HL) Machines X and Y make 60% and 40% of bolts; 1% and 4% are faulty. Find P(a random bolt is faulty).
(HL) Using the same data, find P(made by Y | faulty) (3 s.f.).
(HL) If a test is 99% accurate for people with a disease, then a positive result means a 99% chance of having the disease.
explanation: That is P(+ | D), not P(D | +); the base rate matters.
